In the Maw of the Goddess (J18) it says: 'I know that you are pretenders. Defilers. You should not be here,' and attacks, using unwilling teleportation to send heroes back to J14.
DILEMMA.choice_c: Play along, but prepare. DC 27 Deception to seem compliant. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR. When it finally betrays you, the party gets +2 circumstance to initiative.

DILEMMA.title: The Lens Wants to Be Used
DILEMMA.description: The fulcrum lens in your pack has been humming since you entered this level. Now it's warm, and when you hold it you can feel exactly what it could do - right now - to the obstacle in front of you. Far away, something enormous turns its attention toward the hum.
DILEMMA.choice_a: Use its power. NO DICE ADDED. The obstacle in front of you falls (GM's choice of effect), but Nhimbaloth's gaze brushes the user: doomed 1 until their next daily preparations.
DILEMMA.choice_b: Wrap it in lead or layers of cloth to muffle it. ADD 1 DIE TO JAR. It stops humming, and Belcorra's wisps can no longer sense which of you carries it.
DILEMMA.consequence: Power now vs. safety from the Empty Death
DILEMMA.reward: Bypass one obstacle, or hide the lens-bearer from Belcorra's wisps
DILEMMA.gm_notes: Floor 10. Only for parties carrying at least one fulcrum lens. Belcorra's journals (I58) and The Whispering Reeds both warn that each lens holds a sliver of Nhimbaloth's essence, and that using their powers draws her scrutiny. Belcorra targets lens-bearers in the final battle.
DILEMMA.choice_c: Ignore it. NO DICE ADDED.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Your Light Gutters Out
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A cold draft, a drip from the ceiling, a slip in the muck: the party's main light source goes out, and the dark presses in from every side.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Relight it before anything notices. A free hand and an Interact action relights a torch; a lantern needs a DC by floor (15 on floors 1-2, 18 on 3-4, 20 on 5-6, 23 on 7-8, 26 on 9-10) Thievery or Crafting check to coax its wet wick back to life.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The light flares back before anything stirs.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The party fumbles in the dark for a minute. Anyone without darkvision is blinded until light returns, and anything nearby that lives here gets a free round to notice them.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 minute (NO DICE ADDED) on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR on a failure
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Any floor. Use it where the party is relying on one light. Darkvision creatures on the lower floors (morlocks, ghouls, caligni, drow, urdefhan) treat a dark party as easy prey; if the floor has residents nearby, a failure can lead into the next combat roll with the party unaware.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Stair Gives Way
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The steps you're on groan, then sag. Mortar pours out of the cracks like sand from a broken hourglass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get off the stairs. Basic Reflex save (DC 15 on floors 1-2, 18 on 3-4, 20 on 5-6, 23 on 7-8, 26 on 9-10) as the section drops.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You leap clear to solid stone.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You ride the collapse down and land prone in the rubble: 2d6 bludgeoning on floors 1-2, 4d6 on 3-4, 6d6 on 5-6, 8d6 on 7-8, 10d6 on 9-10.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; clearing a way back up the stair takes 20 minutes (ADD 2 DICE TO JAR) unless someone climbs it (DC by floor Athletics)
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Any floor, on a stair between rooms, not a keyed stairwell. The stair isn't destroyed for good: the party can climb the rubble or clear it. Good for a roll that lands right after the party moves between floors.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Bad Air
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The air turns thick and sweetish. A hero's breath comes short and their vision swims at the edges.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Recognize it and get out. DC by floor (15 on floors 1-2, 18 on 3-4, 20 on 5-6, 23 on 7-8, 26 on 9-10) Nature or Survival to realize it's a pocket of foul air and lead everyone back the way they came.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You back out before anyone breathes too much of it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Everyone who was in the pocket attempts a Fortitude save at the same DC or becomes sickened 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure). The party needs 10 minutes of fresh air to shake it off.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR on a failure
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Any floor below ground. Decay, standing water and alchemy all leave pockets like this. The way forward isn't blocked: it clears in 10 minutes on its own.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Sky King's Gong
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A mitflit lookout perched on a broken wall spots you and starts banging a dented cookpot with a bone, shrieking for the Sky King.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Silence it before the gang comes. The lookout is 30 feet away and 10 feet up on rubble: DC 15 Athletics to scramble up in time, a ranged attack against AC 14, or DC 15 Intimidation to make it drop the pot and run.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The pot clatters into the rubble and the lookout flees squealing. No one came.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The clanging carries across the ruins. 1d3 Mitflits arrive in 2 rounds, hurling insults and junk, and Boss Skrawng's throne room is now expecting company.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mud Licker mitflits; they believe the rusty helmet on Boss Skrawng's throne is the crown of a 'Sky King'. Mitflits flee as soon as they're damaged. If the gong rings, the next combat roll on this floor should be mitflits who know the party is coming (no surprise for the party).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Rotten Boards Over the Water
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The floor here is a skin of rotten planks over a flooded cellar. Your foot goes through with a wet crack.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Throw your weight back. DC 15 Reflex to catch yourself on the joists.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You hang on, and the party picks a way along the joists.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You drop into 10 feet of black, cold water among drowned furniture. Climbing back out is a DC 10 Athletics check; anything you were holding in one hand needs a DC 15 Perception check to find again.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if anyone has to fish out lost gear
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. The water around the ruins is shallow on the trail side and 10-15 feet deep elsewhere, and the cellars flooded long ago. Gauntlight's protective magic has slowed the decay, but not stopped it.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Rubble Slides From the Collapsed Floors
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The upper floors fell in centuries ago. Your passing is enough: a wall of rubble shifts, leans, and comes down.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get clear. Basic DC 15 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You scramble out of the way in a cloud of dust.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 2d6 bludgeoning, and on a failure you're pinned (immobilized) until you Escape (DC 15) or someone digs you out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if anyone has to be dug out
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Rubble areas are open to the sky and difficult terrain. The noise is loud: if the mitflits haven't met the party yet, they come to see what fell (use the next combat roll on this floor).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Fly Breaks Loose
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A droning buzz grows louder over the walls. A giant fly, green-blue and the size of a dog, drops out of the fog, still trailing a frayed rope harness.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 15 Perception to spot it before it dives, or it gets the first attack.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see it coming. Roll initiative normally, or DC 15 Nature to calm it enough to grab the harness rope.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It dives at the nearest hero before you've reacted.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Boss Skrawng wants giant-fly cavalry to conquer Otari, and the Mud Lickers keep flies penned for 'training'. A captured fly with its harness is evidence of the plan. Back in the fly pen, the flies are keyed encounters; this one escaped.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Maggot Rodeo
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Squeals and cursing: two mitflits come around the corner riding, or trying to ride, a giant maggot that has its own ideas about where it's going. Right at you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get out of its way or stop it. DC 15 Acrobatics to dodge as it lurches past, or DC 15 Nature to turn it with a shout and a waved torch.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It veers off into the rubble. The riders tumble off, see you, and run.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It slams through the party and stops, confused and hungry, with two furious mitflits clinging on. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. The Mud Lickers breed giant maggots for Boss Skrawng's army. Mitflits flee as soon as they're damaged; the maggot doesn't.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something in the Rubble Squeaks
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The rubble seethes. A tide of rats pours out of a gap in the stones, fleeing something, or hungry.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 15 Survival or Nature to see which way they're running and step aside, or stand your ground.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You flatten against a wall and the swarm boils past.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The swarm runs straight through the party and turns on whoever is bleeding.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Scuttling vermin are everywhere in the ruins. If the rats were fleeing something, that's a hook for what comes next on this floor.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Fog Off the Fen
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The Fogfen mist rolls in over the broken walls, so thick you can barely see the hero in front of you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Keep your bearings. DC 15 Survival to keep the party together and moving the right way.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You keep the group in a tight line and push on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The party gets turned around in the roofless rubble and loses time. Everything beyond 20 feet is concealed until the fog lifts.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR on a failure
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Only Gauntlight Ruins, the one level above ground, gets the Fogfen. Mitflits know the fog and use it: an ambush in it is easy for them.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Pots of Rot From the Ropes
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: There are ropes strung overhead between the walls. Too late you see the clay pots tied to them, and the little hands cutting them loose.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 12 Perception to have spotted the rope network before the first pot falls. Then DC 15 Reflex to dodge it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The pots burst harmlessly on the stones, spraying dung and maggots. The mitflits overhead jeer and scatter.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A pot breaks over you. DC 15 Fortitude or sickened 1 from the stench of rotten food and mitflit dung.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Mitflits string rope networks through the ruins (the entrance hall has one). DC 15 Nature identifies mitflit dung, if anyone wants to know what that was.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Pale Face in the Puddle
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: In a puddle of standing water, your reflection isn't yours. A pale, sharp-featured woman stares up at you, then smiles.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Hold your nerve. DC 15 Will save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You look away and back; it's only your own face, though the water is very cold.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 1, and you can't shake the feeling of being watched while you're on this floor (Perception checks to notice things behind you take a -1 penalty until you rest).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1, at night especially. It's an echo of Belcorra, whose haunt waits at Gauntlight's base. DC 20 Society to recognize the face from Otari's histories. Lore only: it's an omen, not her.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Ground Sags Into a Sinkhole
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Mud bubbles up between the flagstones, then the whole patch of floor slumps a foot. Something below is giving way.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Jump clear. DC 15 Reflex.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You leap to firm stone as a hole opens behind you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You slide 10 feet down into the mud and take 1d6 bludgeoning. Climbing out is a DC 12 Athletics check.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if anyone has to be hauled out
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 1. Old magic tore holes through this level once (DC 15 Recall Knowledge spots that powerful spells did the damage), and the ground is still settling. The hole doesn't lead anywhere: just mud.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Scavengers for the Temple
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Clanking and grunting up ahead: morlocks are prying iron fittings off an old servants' cupboard, stacking them on a sledge. One sniffs the air and turns toward your light.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Decide fast. DC 16 Stealth to douse the light and slip back before they're sure, or DC 16 Intimidation to make them drop the loot and run.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They lose interest (or flee), leaving the sledge of scrap behind.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 1d3+1 Morlocks charge, clubs and teeth. They fight in the dark if they can.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Ghost Queen morlocks, scavenging parts for the temple King Graulgust is building to win Belcorra's favor. Morlocks have darkvision and hate being lit up. The sledge holds about 15 gp of scrap iron if anyone wants to drag it out (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Lights Out, Teeth In
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Your light catches a glint of eyes for a heartbeat, then a thrown club knocks the torch from a hero's hand and it rolls away, sputtering.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Reflex to keep hold of the light, or DC 16 Perception to see where the attackers are hiding before they close.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You keep your light up and see them coming. Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The light is down and they're among you: the morlocks get a surprise round. Anyone without darkvision is blinded until the light is relit (an Interact action).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Morlocks fight best in the dark and know these halls blind. A party with a second light source shrugs this off; one with a single torch is in trouble.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Swollen Door, Footsteps Behind
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The door ahead is swollen shut with damp. Behind you, something is coming down the hall, unhurried.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get through. Opening it takes one Interact action for someone trained in Athletics, two for anyone else; forcing it outright is DC 16 Athletics.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The door groans open and you're through before whatever it is turns the corner.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The door holds a moment too long. The footsteps are 1d2 Zombie Shamblers, raised by the Gauntlight's pulse, and they reach you as you struggle.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. The doors on this level are sturdy wood swollen with moisture. The dead stir down here because the Gauntlight raises them when it fires: one of the dioramas in the Hall of Hatred shows exactly that, undead rising where the beam falls.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Webs Across the Hall
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The hall ahead is curtained in thick, sticky webbing, and something small and many-legged is moving behind it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Burn through, cut through, or go around. DC 16 Perception to see the spiders before they jump, or they get the first attack.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot them clinging to the ceiling. Roll initiative; burning the webs (1 minute) clears the way.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Dream spiders drop onto the party. Their bite carries dream spider venom (DC 16 Fortitude).
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round to react; burning or cutting through the webs takes 1 minute (NO DICE ADDED)
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Dream spiders serve the web lurker who calls himself king of a 'ghost city' deeper in this level. If the party follows the webs, they lead toward his lair; that is a keyed encounter, not this one.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Junk Barricade Topples
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Morlocks have stacked broken furniture, gears and timbers into a crude wall. As you squeeze past, a beam shifts and the whole heap leans.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get clear. Basic DC 16 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dive out of the way as it crashes down.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 3d6 bludgeoning, and the crash echoes through the level: the morlocks know someone is here.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to dig through the wreck
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. The morlocks build trap gauntlets out of scavenged junk (they used it to guard their king's approach). A hero who spots the problem first (DC 16 Thievery or Crafting, as an exploration-mode check) can steady the beam instead.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Old Spike Launcher
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Click. A cord you never saw, a foot off the floor. Something whirs in the wall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 16 Reflex to throw yourself flat as a jagged spike launches from the masonry.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The spike hisses overhead and buries itself in the opposite wall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The spike hits: 2d6 piercing. The cord is still strung; there may be more down this hall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; searching the rest of the hall for cords takes 10 minutes (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR)
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. The morlocks rig spike launchers with nearly invisible trip lines across their halls, and walk through them freely because they know where the lines are. A hero Searching gets a DC 18 Perception check to spot the cord before it's tripped.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Dead Servants Stir
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A mound of rags in a doorway sits up. Then another. Old servants' livery, rotten through, on bodies that should have stayed down.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Act before they grab someone. DC 16 Religion to recognize them as simple zombies and steer the party out of reach, or engage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You back away into a hall too narrow for them to follow two at a time, and fight on your terms.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They lurch in and grab. Zombie fists Grab, then they bite whoever they're holding.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. When Belcorra died, her servants panicked: some fled, some hid, some were eaten by the librarians on the floor below. Some of the rest are now these.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Gibbering Up the Drain
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: From a drain in the floor comes a sound like a dozen voices talking at once, none of them saying words.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Steel yourself. DC 16 Will save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You shake it off. It's only a noise from far below.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 1, and on a critical failure you're also stupefied 1 for 10 minutes as the babbling crawls into your thoughts.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Something lives in the water below the old well; the noise carries up through the drains (DC 15 Perception to hear it at the well itself). It can't come up this way. A hook toward the pool on the floor below.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Wet Plaster Gives Way
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Moisture beads on every wall down here. A slab of sodden plaster the size of a door peels off the ceiling and drops.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Basic DC 16 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You hear the crack and step back in time.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 2d6 bludgeoning and you're covered in wet plaster: -1 circumstance penalty to Stealth until you clean up (10 minutes).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. Ceilings are 8 feet in the halls. It's a nuisance, but it's loud: a failure tells nearby morlocks someone is moving around.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Banging in the Dark
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Distant, rhythmic banging stops. Then starts again, closer. Then stops.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Find out where it is before it finds you. DC 16 Perception or Survival to place it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It's two morlocks dragging a cart of scrap on iron wheels, heading your way. You have time to set an ambush (you get the surprise round) or let them pass.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You guess wrong and walk straight into them.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 2. The banging is a constant cue on this level: morlocks at work on Graulgust's temple and their machines. Morlock engineers tinker with constructs and traps as easily as breathing.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Robed Readers Look Up
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Between two looming shelves, robed figures are hunched over open books. The page-turning stops. Gray faces turn toward you, and one licks its lips.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Deception or Diplomacy to pass as fellow scholars long enough to back away, or DC 18 Stealth if they haven't fully seen you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They return to their reading, muttering. You back out of the aisle.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 1d3 Ghouls drop their books and come for you. Jaws carry ghoul fever; claws and jaws both paralyze (Fortitude DC from the stat block).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. The Cult of the Canker took Belcorra's library; its ghouls really do read here. They speak and can be bluffed, especially by someone who knows the cult's devotion to the 'canker'. Elves are immune to ghoul paralysis.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Shelf Avalanche
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A looming bookcase, undermined by mold, tips away from the wall. Its neighbors follow like dominoes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get out from under it. Basic DC 18 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dive clear as a tide of books and timber crashes down behind you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 3d6 bludgeoning and you're buried (immobilized) under books until you Escape (DC 18) or are dug out. The crash carries through the library.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if anyone is buried
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. The noise draws cultists: on a failure, the next combat roll on this floor is ghouls who know where the party is. Among the fallen books there might be something Morlibint would pay for (he pays 5 gp per Bulk of Belcorra's books).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Larder Smell
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A door stands ajar onto a cold room. The stink rolling out is so thick it has a taste.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Hold your breath and get past. DC 18 Fortitude save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You gag but keep moving.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1, and sickened 2 on a critical failure, until you spend 10 minutes in cleaner air.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR on a failure
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. The cult keeps meat lockers. Searching one exposes heroes to blue blisters, a flesh-eating disease ghouls find tasty (DC 18 Medicine or Nature recognizes the danger first). Don't let the party into a keyed room from here; this is the smell in the hall.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Canker Priest on Rounds
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Chanting, low and wet. A ghoul in stained vestments comes down the aisle swinging a censer of something that smells of rot, followed by two hunched acolytes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Stealth to get out of the aisle before the procession turns into it, or DC 20 Religion to bluff your way into the procession as fellow worshippers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by, chanting about the canker.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The priest sees you and screams 'Flesh for the High Priestess!' Roll initiative. The priest casts occult spells before closing to claw and bite.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Canker cultists serve High Priestess Nhakazarin, who is building Belcorra a statue of flesh. They revere the 'canker' in a way DC 20 Religion recognizes as worship of decay.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something in the Mist
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A cold, wet mist pools along the floor of the hall, where no water should be. It's moving against the draft.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Nature or Perception to realize it's a creature, not weather, before it surrounds you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You back out of the mist and it follows slowly. Fight on your terms, outside it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The mist thickens around you; a tentacle of congealed water lashes out and grabs.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. A mist stalker lairs on this level. In its mist, the area becomes difficult terrain when it chooses. It's a Level 4 creature: dangerous for a low party. Let them flee.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Violet Growth Reaches Out
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: What looked like a purple mushroom bed against the wall unfolds long, whiplike tentacles.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Nature to recognize it in time and back out of reach, or DC 18 Reflex as the first tentacle lashes out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're out of reach. It can't follow quickly.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A tentacle hits: violet rot (DC 20 Fortitude) starts eating at your flesh.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Violet fungi grow in the damp parts of this level. It's mindless and slow; the party can simply go around (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to find another way).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Hungry One Follows
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The whole time you've been walking, something has been padding behind you. When you stop, it stops.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to catch it, or DC 18 Stealth to lose it among the shelves.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch a pale, gaunt shape ducking behind a shelf, and it knows you saw it. It runs for help (another roll later) or fights if cornered.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It strikes first from behind as the party moves on: a surprise round, and its claws Grab.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. A ghoul stalker, one of the cult's hunters, tracking the party by smell. Its Ghoul Whispers can unsettle the party (DC 17). If the party has met Augrael (the ghoulish morlock who reads alone), he warns them about stalkers.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Book That Bites Back
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A book lies open on a reading stand, pages riffling in a breeze that isn't there. The diagrams on the page are moving.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Close it, or look away. DC 18 Will save as the diagrams crawl toward your eyes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You slam it shut. Inside the cover: a notation in Belcorra's hand.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Stupefied 1 for 1 hour as the necromantic diagrams lodge in your thoughts.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Belcorra's library was a store of necromantic knowledge. DC 18 Arcana or Occultism after closing it identifies a treatise on animating the dead; worth 5 gp per Bulk to Morlibint like any of her books.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Paralysis in the Dark
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A ghoul drops from the top of a shelf right onto a hero, claws first.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Perception to look up in time, or it gets a free Strike before initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You twist away. Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It lands and rakes you: claw damage plus paralysis (Fortitude DC from the stat block). Its friends are coming.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. Ghouls climb the shelves to hunt; the cult considers anyone alive in the library 'cankerous flesh' for Nhakazarin's statue. Elves are immune to ghoul paralysis.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Dust and Mold Spores
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Your passing stirs a cloud of gray dust and musty mold from a shelf of crumbling folios.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 18 Fortitude save, or cover your face in time with DC 18 Survival.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You cough it out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1 and a hacking cough: -2 circumstance penalty to Stealth for 10 minutes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 3. The air on this level is stuffy and full of mold. A coughing party is easy for ghouls to find.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Furniture Moves
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A heavy chair slides across the floor on its own, faster and faster, straight at the back of a hero's knees. A candlestick lifts off a side table.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Reflex to dodge the chair and the candlestick that follows it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They crash into the wall behind you. The room goes still, as if embarrassed.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 2d6 bludgeoning and you're knocked prone. The spirits seem pleased with themselves.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Belcorra's retreat is full of haunted-house effects: chairs sliding, doors closing. DC 19 Religion afterward tells the party these are lingering servant spirits, not anything that can be fought; they're echoes of the household. The real poltergeist is a keyed servant elsewhere on this level.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something Small Crawls After You
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A pale shape scuttles along the baseboard on five fingers. Then another. Severed hands, still wearing rings.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot them before they reach a throat, or DC 19 Reflex when they leap.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see them coming. Roll initiative; they're weak alone.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: One leaps onto a hero and goes for the throat (Throat Grab).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Crawling hands come from Belcorra's shrine to Nhimbaloth on this floor, where they pose as offerings on the altar (DC 16 Perception there). These have wandered. Each was anointed with someone's blood and hunts that quarry; whose blood is a hook.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Guest Who Never Left
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A skeleton in rotted finery sits slumped at a side table, a goblet still in its hand. As you pass, a soft light kindles in its eye sockets and it stands.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Religion to recognize a corpselight (a wisp-like undead that wears corpses) before it attacks, or DC 19 Perception to notice the glow first.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You know what it is; you can keep it out of reach of other corpses, where it would claim a new body.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It lurches into you; roll initiative. If it's destroyed near another corpse, the light can move on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Belcorra poisoned the guests at one of her dinners; their skeletons now host corpselights. No faction holds this floor. This one wandered from the party.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Leeches in the Wet
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A dark puddle across the hall ripples. Then a leech as long as your arm surges out of it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to see it before it latches on, or DC 19 Athletics to leap the puddle.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're past it or ready for it. Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It latches on (Grab) and starts draining blood.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Leeches here are a sign of Volluk, Belcorra's apprentice, who became a worm-that-walks made of leeches and lairs in a lounge on this floor. A trail of them is lore, not him: he's a keyed encounter.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Fungus Bursts Underfoot
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The fungi grow thick here, over fine carpets and old furniture. A puffball the size of a melon pops under a boot and fills the air with spores.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Fortitude save against the spore cloud.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You hold your breath and step out of the cloud.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1 and dazzled for 1 minute as the spores sting your eyes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Profusions of fungi grow over Belcorra's old luxuries. DC 19 Nature afterward identifies the puffballs; harmless once you know to step around them.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Lights That Aren't Yours
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Ahead, a hovering light bobs as if someone is carrying a lantern. When you follow, it drifts deeper, and another appears behind you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Occultism or Nature to recognize wisps feeding on confusion, or DC 19 Will to keep your wits.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You refuse to follow. They flicker, frustrated, and attack or fade.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The party gets turned around chasing them (ADD 1 DIE TO JAR), and they strike while you're lost and confused.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Flickerwisps feed on confusion (Consume Confusion). They gather near the shrine and the bound bartender's cell on this level.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Quills From the Dark
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A rattle like a dry reed fan, then a hiss. Something long and many-legged, with quills down its back, has followed your scent from its pen.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Perception to spot it before it fires its quills, or it gets a free ranged Strike.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You spot it in the shadows. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A volley of venomous quills hits first: scalathrax venom (DC 21 Fortitude).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Belcorra kept scalathrax in a pen here, and one was famously teleported up to Floor 2 by the Gauntlight's first firing. This one got loose. Level 4: dangerous for a party coming down from Floor 3.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Despair Seeps Through the Walls
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A cold weight settles on the party. Every one of you suddenly knows, with total certainty, that nothing you do here matters.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Resist it. DC 19 Will save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You shrug it off, though the feeling lingers like a bad taste.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure), and the condition can't be reduced below 1 until you leave this hall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. It leaks from Belcorra's shrine to Nhimbaloth, the uncaring goddess of despair and ghosts. DC 25 Religion names the source.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Howl From the Sea Caves
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A long, hungry howl rolls up through the stone from somewhere toward the sea. Then the patter of paws, coming closer.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Survival to read the sound and find a defensible doorway in time.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You put your backs to a doorway; only one can reach you at a time.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The wolves catch you in the open and use their numbers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. The wolves run with Jaul Mezmin, a werewolf who murdered Keeleno Lathenar's daughter and hides in the pavilion by the sea caves. He's a keyed encounter; these are his wolves, and their trail leads to him.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Retreat Remembers You
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: For one heartbeat the hall is new: polished floors, servants hurrying past with trays. One of them looks straight at you and screams.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 19 Will save to keep your bearings as the vision snaps away.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You blink, and it's ruins again. You keep your feet.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You lash out or bolt at the vision: stunned 1, and the scream echoes for real through the halls.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 4. Spectral visions of rooms as they looked 500 years ago are common here. The ecology's 'The Retreat As It Was' is the gentler version; this one is louder, and on a failure whatever lives nearby has heard.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Failed Experiment Weeps
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A sound like a child crying echoes off the walls. Around the corner shambles a lumpy, sobbing thing with long claws, its stomach churning visibly.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Will save against its piteous moaning, then act: DC 20 Stealth to get out of earshot, or fight.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You harden yourself to the sound and slip away, or fight with clear heads.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1 from the moan (DC 17 Will each turn you're within 60 feet), and it's seen you. It spews digestive acid and closes to claw.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Grothluts are failed fleshwarping experiments that Jafaki's seugathi dump on this level. They were people once; DC 20 Medicine or Occultism confirms it, a grim hook for the labs below.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Garbage Pile Stands Up
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A heap of discarded flesh and bone in the corner, the leavings of the labs below, heaves itself upright and reaches for you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Perception to notice the heap breathing before you walk past it, or DC 20 Reflex as it lunges.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see it first and back off out of its reach. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A fleshy slap and it Grabs, then squeezes the life out of whoever it holds (Sapping Squeeze).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Shanrigol heaps rise on their own from the seugathi's dumped remains. Keep them clumsy and relentless; they don't flee.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Door Swings Shut
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The heavy iron-banded door is weighted to swing closed, and it does, right as the party is half through. Something on the far side snarls.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Catch it. DC 20 Athletics to hold it open long enough for everyone to get through (or back out).
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Everyone makes it to the same side.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The party is split: the door shuts between them, and opening it again takes an Interact action from the other side while whatever is snarling arrives.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Doors here are wood banded with iron, gouged and scarred by beasts, and weighted to swing shut after a few moments unless propped. If something is on the other side, use the next combat roll on this floor. Propping doors as a habit (wedges, spikes) prevents this.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Statues That Weren't Always
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A gray figure crouches mid-stride in the dust, weapon raised: stone, but so lifelike you can see the stitching on its armor. And fresh tracks lead past it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Don't meet its eyes. The basilisk is nearby: DC 20 Perception to spot it before it spots you, or DC 20 Nature to realize what the statue means and avert your gazes in time.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see it coming with your eyes lowered, taking a penalty on attacks but not on your saves. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It catches a hero's gaze: DC 22 Fortitude against its Petrifying Gaze (slowed 1 on a failure, and worse if it happens again).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. A mated pair of basilisks hunts this level; their keyed lair holds a petrified urdefhan and a petrified mulventok. This is one of the pair, away from its lair. Level 5.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Chest Has Teeth
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: In a side alcove, an iron-bound chest sits with its lid ajar, a gleam of coins inside. Too good to be true.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Perception or Arcana to see that the chest's wood grain is wrong before anyone reaches in.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You prod it from a distance and it reveals itself, frustrated.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A hero reaches in and the chest bites down (Improved Grab).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Mimics lurk on this level (a keyed pair elsewhere). They gather real coins as bait; a defeated one has 2d10 gp of old coins inside it.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Pit Edge Crumbles
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The floor at the edge of a dark shaft gives way under a careless step.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Reflex to grab the edge.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch the lip and haul yourself back.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You fall 20 feet: 2d6 bludgeoning, and you land in the dark among broken claws and carapace. Climbing out is DC 20 Athletics.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to get someone out
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. The arena level is riddled with pits, shafts and chutes (some drop all the way to the labs on Floor 6). This one is just a pit; don't drop the party a floor.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Crowd Roars
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: From the empty stands comes the roar of a crowd that isn't there: bloodthirsty, chanting for a kill. For a moment you feel their eyes on you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Will save as the phantom crowd demands a show.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You ignore it; the roar fades into silence.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 1, and you're seized with the urge to fight: until the end of your next turn, you must Strike or Stride toward the nearest creature (ally or foe) if you can.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Belcorra built this level to test her minions' and prisoners' resolve, and hoped to run a gladiator facility here. The echo of those fights lingers. Use it with an ally in reach for drama, or alone as atmosphere.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Babbling in the Dark
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A sound of many mouths talking at once, wet and senseless, coming from a heap of flesh with eyes all over it, rolling toward you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Will save against the gibbering, then act fast: DC 20 Acrobatics to get past it, or fight.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You keep your head and choose your ground.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Its gibbering scrambles your thoughts and it rolls forward, mouths biting and spitting acid that can blind (DC from its stat block).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. A gibbering mouther, another of Jafaki's dumped failures; one also guards the shaft at the top of this level. Level 5.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something Bounces
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A rubbery thump, then another, quicker: something heavy is bouncing down the corridor toward you, spitting acid as it comes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 20 Perception to spot it and brace, or it slams into the front hero first.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You brace. Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It slams into a hero (Bouncing Slam, a Shove) and its acid spit burns (persistent acid).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Gibtas bounders, seugathi pets gone feral, roam the balconies here. Level 5.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Fresh Gouges
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Fresh claw gouges score the wall at head height, and the dust is churned with strange tracks. Something big passed here minutes ago and might come back.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Choose: DC 20 Survival to read the tracks and avoid its path, or press on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You know which way it went and take another route. NO DICE ADDED.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You go the same way it did. The next combat roll on this floor is it, and it's aware of you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if you take the long way around anyway
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 5. Strange tracks and gouges are this level's signature. A critical success on Survival identifies the beast (basilisk, gibtas, or one of the bigger dumped experiments).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Specimen Collection
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A long, pale worm-body in a stained apron glides around the corner, dragging a whimpering grothlut on a chain. Its eyeless head turns toward you, and you feel it reading you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Stealth to get out of its sight before it finishes, or DC 22 Deception to present yourselves as another lab's subjects being moved.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It loses interest and glides on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It wants you for the labs. It sets the grothlut on you and fights with venom-coated blade and occult spells.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Jafaki's seugathi fleshwarp captives into increasingly bizarre creatures. Seugathi read minds (Mind Reading) and envenom their weapons. A failure here means Jafaki's lab knows strangers are on the level.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Buzzing at the Edge of Sight
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A droning hum, then nothing. Something invisible just passed close enough to stir your hair.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Perception to pinpoint it, or DC 22 Deception to call out that you have business with Urevian.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch it (a fat fly-devil, now visible) and it either flees to report or bargains for its life.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It slips away to report you to the devils below, and the next devil you meet knows your faces.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Zebubs are the devils' spies; there's a 1-in-3 chance of a zebub patrol on this level at any time. The devils of Floor 7 under Urevian are encroaching on the labs, and the seugathi resist them. Cocytan filth on its mandibles is a disease.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Acid Across the Floor
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A cracked vat has been leaking for days. The floor ahead is pitted and smoking, and the puddle is spreading toward you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Acrobatics to leap the spill, or DC 22 Reflex if it splashes up as you cross.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're over it, boots smoking.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 4d6 acid and 1d6 persistent acid as it eats into your boots.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to find another way around
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Acid pitting on floors and doors is everywhere on this level. DC 22 Crafting identifies the reagent and how to neutralize it (with sand, 10 minutes).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Drain Oozes
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A pale, amber mass flows up out of a floor drain like a tide coming in, and reaches for the nearest leg.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Perception to see it before it's around your feet, or DC 22 Reflex as it surges.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're out of reach before it fully emerges.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It grabs and constricts, its acid eating flesh but not armor or bone.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. The labs dispose of failures and spills down the drains, and ochre jellies thrive on it (two live in the dissection chamber). It's slow (AC 12, lots of HP): running is a fine answer.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Last Call at the Warped Brew
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Three morlocks stagger down the hall, arm in arm, singing badly and smelling of fungus beer. They stop dead when they see you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Diplomacy to join the song (or offer a round), or DC 22 Intimidation to send them reeling home.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They wave you on, or tell you something useful about the tavern: drink and you might hear the band.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They're mean drunks: three morlocks swing clubs. They flee below 10 HP.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. The Warped Brew Tavern (F11) is a strangely civilized place in the middle of the labs, where the smell of spilled fungus beer replaces the chemicals. Its regulars are morlocks; the bouncer is a lazy drider who reads romance novels.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Shriek, Then Running Feet
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A distant shriek, and then bare feet slapping stone, coming fast: a half-changed morlock, skin split by new growths, sprints past you sobbing. Behind it, a drider.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Decide in a heartbeat. DC 22 Stealth to stay out of the hunt, or step in.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The drider passes; the hunt goes on without you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The drider sees you as fresh specimens and attacks with glaive, venom and webs.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Distant shrieks are this level's background noise. Driders serve the seugathi as bodyguards. Saving the escapee (they flee below 10 HP) gets a guide to the tavern and a witness to what happens in the labs.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Cages Are Open
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A horrid stench rolls ahead of them: two gray, gaunt ghouls with eyes like coals, cage bars still in their claws. They smell you and howl.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Hold your breath. DC 22 Fortitude against the stench as they close, then roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You fight with clear heads.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1 from the stench, and they reach you first. Ghast claws and jaws paralyze; ghast fever is a disease.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. The seugathi keep ghasts caged (F21) as test subjects. These broke out. Elves aren't immune to ghast paralysis.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Solvent Fire
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A torch flame touches a slick on the floor you mistook for water. It goes up with a whoomph.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get out of it. Basic DC 22 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You leap clear of the flames.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 3d6 fire and 1d6 persistent fire; the smoke fills the corridor (concealed) for 1 minute.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. The labs reek of acrid chemicals and spilled solvents. The denizens see in the dark and don't carry flames: open fire is the party's risk alone. Darkvision-only parties never trigger this.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something Drops From the Shaft
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A grate overhead clangs open. A body drops from a shaft above and lands in a wet heap in front of you, then gets up.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 22 Reflex to dodge the fall, then DC 22 Will against its moaning.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're out of the way and steady.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It lands on someone (2d6 bludgeoning) and its piteous moan sickens.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Shafts connect the arena above with the labs, and the seugathi drop failures down them. A grothlut: once a person.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Mind Brushes Yours
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A cold touch behind your eyes, like fingers flicking through a book. Someone, somewhere nearby, is reading you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Will save to shut them out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You slam the door on the intruding thought. Whoever it was now knows you're strong-willed.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They learn your plans and fears. The next seugathi or drider the party meets on this floor is ready for them: no surprise for the party, and they've prepared for the party's tactics.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 6. Seugathi are telepathic and cast mind reading at will. DC 22 Occultism afterward places the reader in a direction, which is a lead on a lab.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: They Know Your Names
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A bearded devil steps out of a doorway ahead, glaive lowered, two hunched grothluts on leashes at its heels. 'You're late,' it says, and calls one of you by name.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Deception to claim you're expected by Urevian, or DC 23 Intimidation to face it down; otherwise fight.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It hesitates, unsure whether you're on Urevian's books, and lets you pass to check.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It looses the grothluts and attacks. Its glaive leaves infernal wounds; its beard carries Avernal fever.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Urevian has been spying on Carman Rajani, so his devils know a little about the heroes: have them call heroes by name and predict tactics the party discussed around Carman. The barbazu trains grothluts as hounds. The level is on reasonably high alert.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Door Flares
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: You ease a stone-and-iron door open and fire flickers all around its edges, bright in the dim red light. Down the hall, something turns toward the glow.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Stealth to get through and out of sight before it comes to look. A hero trained in Religion who speaks the brief incantation while opening a door prevents the flare entirely (no action).
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: Whatever it was loses interest.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A zebub buzzes over to investigate and reports the party; the next combat roll on this floor is devils who know you're here.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Every door on the prison level flickers with fire at the edges when it opens or closes, which makes sneaking hard. Teach the incantation trick once the party notices the pattern (DC 23 Religion as a Recall Knowledge).

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Shift Change
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Heavy steps and the scrape of chitin on stone: a drider and a hulking mulventok coming off watch, heading for the barracks, straight down this hall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Stealth to find a cell to duck into, or DC 23 Deception to pass as new arrivals for Urevian's army.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass, arguing about rations.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They see you and attack; if the fight runs 3 rounds, more fleshwarps come from the barracks.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Urevian's fleshwarp troops (driders and mulventoks from the labs above) bunk in the barracks near the haunted prison office. They're preparing to invade the surface.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something Light-Fingered
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A tug at a belt pouch. When the hero looks down, the pouch is open, and something invisible is giggling.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Perception to locate the invisible thief before it gets away.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You grab a struggling imp by the tail. It offers to trade what it knows for its freedom.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It escapes with one consumable item (GM's choice) and tells everyone on the level what you carry.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Imps run errands for the devils here. This one isn't Szek (who's imprisoned and eager to deal), but it knows where she is. Imp stingers carry venom.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Symbols Ignite
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The diabolic symbols carved along this wall glow brighter as you pass, then burst into flame, one after another, chasing you down the hall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Run. Basic DC 23 Reflex save as the fire races along the wall.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're past the last symbol as it flares.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 5d6 fire and the flames show anyone watching where you are.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. The dim red light on this level comes from flickering flames and glowing diabolic symbols. DC 23 Religion afterward reads them as a warding prayer to Asmodeus; a hero who knows that can recite past the next ones.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Smoke From the Forge
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Thick, sulfurous smoke rolls down the hall from somewhere ahead, where hammers ring on metal.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Fortitude save as you push through.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You keep your breath and push through.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 1, and everything beyond 10 feet is concealed while you're in the smoke (1 minute).
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to go around
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. The hellforge where the devils make hellforged weapons fills this level with smoke and the stench of brimstone. DC 22 Crafting or Religion knows holy water destroys a hellforge, a hook for the keyed room.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Eerie Silence
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Between one step and the next, all sound stops. You can see a companion's mouth move, but you hear nothing.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Perception to spot the shimmer in the air (a buzzing, invisible watcher) before it acts.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch the shape at the edge of your sight and signal the others.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: A zebub, invisible, has been watching you in the silence; it slips away to report, and the party is off-guard to the next thing that comes.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Eerie silence is one of this level's cues. Zebubs are the devils' eyes, invisible at will.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Arrows From the Dark Above
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: With a rustle of wings, a fury in shining armor drops from the 20-foot ceiling, bow drawn.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Perception to spot her before she looses, or she gets a free Strike.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see her. Roll initiative; she prefers to fight from the air.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: An arrow hits before you know she's there.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Erinyes serve Urevian here (two sisters forge gates in one keyed room; one is the level's smith). This one is on patrol. Level 8: a deadly fight for a party new to this floor; she may parley for Urevian instead.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Contract Is Being Enforced
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Screaming ahead. A bearded devil is dragging a struggling drider down the hall by its hair. 'Clause nine,' it growls. It sees you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 23 Society or Legal Lore to point out a flaw in the clause it's citing (it stops to check), or DC 23 Stealth to back away.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The devil stops to argue the clause, and the drider flees. The devil owes you a grudging respect.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Both turn on you: the drider for a chance to earn its freedom.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Devils respect contracts and authority. Urevian drafts the contracts himself (his Legal Lore DC is 33), and his underlings enforce them to the letter.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Heat Through the Floor
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The stone underfoot is hot through your boots. A seam in the floor glows orange; the magma below is closer than it should be.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get across. DC 23 Acrobatics to pick the cool stones, or DC 23 Fortitude to grit through.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You cross without lingering.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 4d6 fire and your boots smolder (1d6 persistent fire until you stop to put them out).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 7. Magma powers the summoning circle (DC 23 Crafting or Religion), and its heat bleeds into nearby halls. A crack in one ceiling lets lake water in from the level above.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Hands Out of the Mud
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The mud at your feet heaves. Small, leathery hands claw up out of it, then small mummified bodies, crowned with moss.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Perception to see the mud stir before they're on you, or DC 24 Reflex to pull free of their first grab.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're out of the mud before they finish rising. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They rise among you and strike first. Each fist carries bog rot, a curse and disease that can't be healed normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. The Children of Belcorra are deep gnomes who became bog mummies. They're listless and can give clues about Belcorra's return if spoken to in Gnomish (DC 24 Diplomacy) before they attack. Remove curse ends bog rot.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Darkness Falls on the Path
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Your light shrinks to nothing as magical darkness swallows the trail. Soft footsteps on every side.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Perception to hear where they are, or DC 24 Occultism or Religion to counter-chant the darkness away for a moment.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You catch them moving. Roll initiative normally; they're less fond of a fair fight.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Caligni slip in from the dark and stab with poisoned blades (black smear poison), sneak attacking the off-guard.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Adult caligni cultists under Dulac, the Custodian, cast darkness at will. They can give clues about Belcorra's return if the party talks rather than fights; their leaders are keyed encounters.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something in the Shallows
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Distant splashing gets closer. A chitinous shape the size of a horse rises from the lake edge, pincers wide, tentacles twitching around its mouth.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Perception to spot it before it grabs, or DC 24 Athletics to get the party up the bank and away from the water.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You're out of the shallows; it hesitates to leave the water.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It grabs a hero with a pincer and its paralytic tentacles go to work.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Chuuls hunt the lake and caves (a pair lairs in one cave). It flees below 20 HP. Near the lake, roll a DC 5 flat check every 15 minutes for a random lake encounter.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Pale Light Feeding
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A glowing wisp drifts out of the foul mist, pulsing brighter as it nears. Your hope seems to drain toward it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Will save to steady yourself, then act: fight or flee before it feeds.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see it for what it is: a soul feeder. Roll initiative.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 1, and it feeds on your fear first.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Dread wisps serve Nhimbaloth; a pair lairs on this level near the temple swamp basins. Level 9: very dangerous. Retreat is a fine answer.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Fungus Tower Falls
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: One of the towering fungi, rotten at the base, splits with a sound like wet wood and topples toward you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Get out of its path. Basic DC 24 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You throw yourself aside as it crashes down in a cloud of glowing spores.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 6d6 bludgeoning, and you're pinned under it (immobilized) until you Escape (DC 24) or are pulled free.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR if anyone is pinned
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Belcorra's farm is an overgrown fungal swamp under 50-foot cavern ceilings. The crash is loud enough to bring whatever lives nearby.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Mold Takes Hold
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Creeping tendrils of mold cover the walls here. As you pass, they tighten around an ankle, cold and wet, and start to pull.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Break free. DC 24 Athletics or Acrobatics.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You tear loose, leaving a strip of boot behind.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You're grabbed and dragged against the wall: 3d6 poison as the mold feeds, and you stay grabbed until you Escape (DC 24).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Creeping mold and earthy rot are everywhere. DC 24 Nature identifies the mold and the dry patches it avoids, so the party can pick a safe route from here on.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Drow on the Hunt
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: An arrow thuds into a fungus stalk a hand's width from your head: a warning shot. Two cloaked drow step out of the mist, bows drawn.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Diplomacy to convince them you're not their enemies, or DC 24 Stealth to vanish back into the mist.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They lower their bows and ask your business. They hunt for Yldaris, and they don't love the cult or the urdefhan either.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They shoot to kill.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Drow hunters from Yldaris (led by Quara Orshendiel, on the floor below) patrol this level. They can become allies; rescuing Falxi Orshendiel from the labs gives +4 to Diplomacy with them.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Stare That Kills
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A gaunt gray figure, wrong in every proportion, stands in a doorway of fungal wood. Its eyes are holes. It turns them on you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Look away. DC 24 Perception to spot it before you meet its gaze.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You avert your eyes in time. Fight it without looking (a penalty on attacks, not on your saves).
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You meet its gaze: Death Gaze (Fortitude save from its stat block) as it lurches forward.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Bodaks lair among the Children of Belcorra (three in one cave); one has wandered. Any humanoid who dies while drained by a bodak rises as one. Level 8.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Whispers Off the Water
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A voice murmurs from somewhere across the lake, too low to make out, but it slides under your thoughts and stays there.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Will save, and each minute you stay within earshot, another.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You shake it off and keep moving.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Stupefied 1 (stupefied 2 on a critical failure) for as long as you can hear it, up to stupefied 4.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to take the long way around
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. Distracting whispers come from the lair of Urthagul, the gug mystic who holds the Crimson Lens. Lore only: the whispers point the way to a keyed encounter.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Footprints That Are Fresh
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Muddy footprints, small and many, lead off the path and stop at a wall. They don't come back out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 24 Perception to find the hidden door before whoever made them comes back.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You find the seam and hear caligni voices beyond, chanting. You can listen in (DC 24 Society: they speak of the Ghost Queen's return) or move on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The door opens while you're searching it: 2 Caligni Stalkers, surprised but armed.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 8. The cult's areas are full of secret doors. The door is a real one on the map (the cult's rooms); don't invent a passage, just use the nearest cult door.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: A Good Day to Kill
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Two gaunt, pale-skinned urdefhan rise from behind a crystal outcrop, grinning with too many teeth. 'We meet on a good day to kill,' one says, and draws a serrated blade.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Perception to have spotted them first (no surprise round), or DC 26 Intimidation to answer the challenge so they fight honorably, one on one.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see them coming, or they accept a duel's terms. Roll initiative normally.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They hit first: blades that cause bleeding and a Wicked Bite, and they throw necrotic bombs at anyone hanging back.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Urdefhan death scouts, hunters of the war band whose champion Khurfel carries the Emerald Lens. They quote his saying and respect a party that answers in kind. In the caverns, roll a DC 5 flat check every 15 minutes for a random encounter.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Lashes From the Ledge
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A whip of jagged chain cracks out of the dark above and wraps around a hero's arm. Two urdefhan grin down from a ledge 20 feet up.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Reflex to twist free before the lash yanks you off your feet.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You tear loose. Roll initiative; they hold the high ground.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You're grabbed and dragged toward the ledge, and the second lasher bites (Wicked Bite).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Urdefhan lashers fight from ledges with shauth lashes and drift down unharmed (feather fall at will). The cavern ceilings run 20-40 feet: lots of ledges.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Green Drips From the Mold
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Streamers of mold hang from the ceiling here. One of them isn't mold: a glob of green slime lets go and falls toward a hero's head.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Reflex to dodge.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It splashes on the stone beside you and starts dissolving it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It lands on you: 6d6 acid, and it keeps eating (2d6 persistent acid) until scraped off or burned (an Interact action, or any fire or cold damage).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Green slime grows among the mold streamers in places (one patch guards some old coins). A hero Searching gets a DC 28 Perception check to spot it in time.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Slick Slime on the Slope
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The cavern floor tilts toward darkness, and it's covered in a patch of slick, glistening slime.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Acrobatics to keep your feet.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You pick your way across.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You fall prone and slide 20 feet down the slope toward a drop, catching the edge at the last moment (6d6 bludgeoning from rocks on the way). Climbing back up is DC 26 Athletics.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: 1 round; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to climb back up
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Patches of slick slime are one of this level's cues. The drop is a real cavern edge, not a new passage.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Something Big Is Coming
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A roar echoes through the caverns, rolling on and on off the rough walls. The fungus nearby shivers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Survival or Nature to tell how big, how far, and which way it's heading.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: It's far off and heading away. You know where not to go.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You misjudge it: a cave bear barrels around the corner, already charging (Rush).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Roaring echoes carry everywhere in the Hunting Grounds; some of the most powerful monsters in the adventure live here (a black dragon among them). This one is only a bear.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Refugees and Their Hunters
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Three small, gray-skinned caligni run past, gasping, one carrying another. A moment later, the war cries of their pursuers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Decide now. DC 26 Stealth to hide everyone (caligni included), or turn and meet the hunters.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The urdefhan run past. The caligni, shaking, thank you in Undercommon and tell you about their lodge and its mage.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: The hunters find you all: four urdefhan warriors with rhoka swords and bows.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. The caligni refugees follow the mage Galudu, who wants a safe way out of the Vaults. Helping them earns her goodwill (and her wand as a reward). The urdefhan hunt anything weaker for sport.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Wardens at the Crossing
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: An Elven challenge rings out of the dark, and the points of arrows glint from three directions.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Answer it. DC 26 Diplomacy (Elven helps: +2), or name a friend of Yldaris such as Falxi or Iribo.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The drow lower their bows and escort you toward Yldaris, or wave you through.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They shoot to drive you off. If you hold your ground, they fight.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Yldaris's drow (led by Quara Orshendiel) are key allies: Quara can explain the fulcrum lenses. Entering Yldaris takes a secret knock. Rescuing Falxi Orshendiel earlier makes this easy.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Cavern Ceiling Sheds
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A crack like thunder. A slab of the rough stone ceiling, 40 feet up, comes loose.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Basic DC 26 Reflex save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You dive clear as it shatters across the cavern floor.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: 7d6 bludgeoning from the falling stone, and the noise brings whatever is nearby.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Large caverns here have 40-foot ceilings. On a failure, roll the floor's random encounter check immediately.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Torment Priest
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A robed urdefhan with a warhammer and a bloodstained holy symbol watches you from across a stream, chanting. Shadows deepen around you.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Religion to recognize the daemonic prayer and break its line of sight before the spell lands.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You duck behind fungus stalks; its spell fizzles.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Its spells land first (harm, paralyze), and two warriors charge while you're reeling.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Urdefhan tormentors serve daemons with rituals and divine spells. This one leads a hunting pair.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Strange Tracks, Still Warm
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Tracks in the slime: clawed, many, and heavy. Fresh droppings beside them, still warm.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 26 Survival to read them, or DC 26 Nature to identify the creature.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You know what it is and where it beds down. You can avoid it entirely or plan an ambush (the party gets the surprise round if it chooses to hunt it).
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You follow the trail without understanding it and end up in its path.
ACTIVE_THREAT.time_cost: NO DICE ADDED on a success; ADD 1 DIE TO JAR to backtrack on a failure
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 9. Strange tracks are this level's signature. Use the trail to steer the party toward (or away from) one of the level's big keyed monsters; on a failure, the next combat roll here is that creature's hunting ground.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Procession of the Dead
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Robed figures drift down the black-stone hall in single file, translucent, chanting without sound. The one at the front raises a ghostly blowgun.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 27 Stealth to press into a side alcove and let the procession pass, or DC 27 Religion to join the silent chant convincingly.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: They pass by, intent on a rite five hundred years over.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: They turn on you, vile touches draining life and corrupting souls (DC 24 Will).
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. The cult of Nhimbaloth is gone; only cultist specters remain, still performing the temple's rites. Their keyed group guards the Challenge of Souls. These have strayed. This level's denizens mostly stay put: use this sparingly.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Fog With Fingers
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The fog that hangs in this temple thickens and reaches for you, and for a moment it has a hand: seven long, pale fingers.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Hold on to yourself. DC 27 Will save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: The fog is only fog again, cold on your skin.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Frightened 2, and you're certain something vast has noticed you. On a critical failure, you're also stupefied 1 until you rest.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. Nhimbaloth, the Empty Death, is unseen here except as a mist with seven-fingered tentacles. Lore only: the goddess doesn't act through this. DC 25 Religion recognizes her.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Eyes in the Dark
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: A faint light hangs in the air far behind the party, and has been there for some time. When you turn, it goes out.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 27 Perception to spot it properly, or DC 27 Stealth to lose it.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You see it: a dread wisp, keeping its distance. It drifts away, knowing it's been seen.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: It follows you all the way and reports. The next combat roll on this floor comes with the party off-guard.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. The Lady's Whisper, Nhimbaloth's undead gatekeeper, controls the temple's doors and is shadowed by dread wisps. Lore and threat: it watches the party while it decides whether to guide them through the trials or kill them.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Swamp Air
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The clammy air turns thick and green near the drop to the swamp below. Breathing it burns.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 27 Fortitude save, or DC 27 Survival to find the cleaner air along the ceiling and move quickly.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You get through holding your breath.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Sickened 2 (sickened 4 on a critical failure) from the toxic swamp air.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. The Challenge of the Swamp lies below; its air is toxic. The ecology's 'Toxic Water' is the water itself; this is the air drifting up through the pipes.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: Memories on the Walls
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: The black stone wall flashes white, then fills with moving pictures: a fight you lost, a friend you couldn't save, a trap you walked into. They're yours.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: Avert your gaze (and gain its bonus) and make a DC 27 Will save.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You turn away from the images and walk on.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: Stupefied 2 for 1 hour, and frightened 1.
ACTIVE_THREAT.gm_notes: Floor 10. The illusions of the Challenge of Despair leak beyond their halls. Pull the images from the party's real failures in the campaign: a foe they fled, a trap that hurt them. Don't put the party inside the trial halls with this event.

ACTIVE_THREAT.title: The Black Stone Sweats
ACTIVE_THREAT.description: Condensation streams down the walls and pools on the black stone floor. It's slick as oil.
ACTIVE_THREAT.immediate_action: DC 27 Acrobatics to keep your footing on the wet stone.
ACTIVE_THREAT.success: You move carefully and keep your feet.
ACTIVE_THREAT.failure: You fall prone and slide into the carved wall: 4d6 bludgeoning, and anything in your hands goes skittering across the floor.
